{{See also|Mawdredge Dagger}} {{Infobox/Weapon |rarity = e |slayer_level_requirement = Blaze Slayer 4 |damage = +130 |strength = +55 |crit_damage = +20% |attack_speed = +10% |upgrades_from = Firedust Dagger |upgrades_to = Pyrochaos Dagger |gemstone_slots = *1 Combat &250000& *1 Opal &500000& |enchantable = y |reforgeable = y |museum = y |museum_xp = 10 |museum_category = combat |raw_materials = *8800 Magmafish *1152 Derelict Ashe *5760 Red Sand *5760 Mycelium *23040 Magma Cream *23040 Glowstone Dust *23040 Nether Wart *23040 Blaze Rod *1 Stick |bazaar_not_including=[[Stick]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *9 MOLTEN_POWDER *110 Silver Magmafish |id = BURSTFIRE_DAGGER }} The '''Kindlebane Dagger''' is an {{Epic}} [[Sword]]. It is unlocked at {{Coll|Blaze Slayer IV}}. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Blaze Slayer 4}} |A1 = |B1 = Gold Magmafish |C1 = |A2 = |B2 = Molten Powder, 8 |C2 = |A3 = |B3 = Firedust Dagger |C3 = |Output = Kindlebane Dagger }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |type = Sword |name = Kindlebane Dagger |rarity = e |damage = 130 |attack_speed = 10 |crit_damage = 20 |strength = 55 |special_effect = Deal {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs.
Deal {{Red|1.2x}} damage to {{mt|Wither}} mobs.
Gain {{stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. |item_ability_name = Attunement |item_ability_description = Swap between {{Grey|Ashen}} and {{Yellow|Auric}} mode in order to attack through Hellion Shields. |item_ability_activation = On Right Click |item_ability_name2 = Burning Vengeance ﬗ |item_ability_description2 = On hit, {{Red|repeat}} the last 6 hits of dealt damage after {{Green|6s}} if the Hellion Shield has switched attunement. }} The '''Kindlebane Dagger''' deals {{Red|1.5x}} damage to {{mt|Infernal}} mobs and {{Red|1.2x}} damage to {{mt|Skeletal}} mobs. Additionally, it provides {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against {{mt|Infernal}} mobs. The '''Kindlebane Dagger''' has {{Green|2}} abilities: * {{AN|Attunement}} allows the wielder to swap between {{DarkGray|'''Ashen'''}} and {{Yellow|'''Auric'''}} attunements in order to attack through the {{MobSprite|Inferno Demonlord}}'s {{AN|Hellion Shield}} ability. When switching attunement, the '''Kindlebane Dagger''' changes appearance from a {{Item|Iron Sword|link=}} to a {{Item|Golden Sword|link=}}. * {{AN|Burning Vengeance}} allows the wielder to {{Red|repeat}} the last {{Green|6}} hits of dealt damage after {{Green|6s}} upon hit if the {{AN|Hellion Shield}} has switched attunement. This does not affect the damage immunity of demons, and has a cap of {{Stat|dmg|25,000,000}}. === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/Mar 21|link=none|[[File:Kindlebane Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Kindlebane Dagger'''.}} {{History|2024/Nov 25|link=none|'''Kindlebane Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against Blazes.}} {{History|2024/Nov 26|link=none|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Red|50M}} damage.}} {{History|2026/Jun 24|[[File:Kindlebane Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Kindlebane Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Kindlebane Dagger (v1).png|26px]] Added '''Kindlebane Dagger'''.}} {{History|0.20.9|'''Kindlebane Dagger''' now grants {{Stat|Combat Wisdom|+30}} against Blazes.|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Red|50M}} damage.}} {{History|0.23.3|'''Kindlebane Dagger''' perks changed to affect {{mt|Infernal}} and {{mt|Wither}} mobs.}} {{History|2026/Jan 12|{{AN|Burning Vengeance}} is now capped at {{Stat|Damage|25M}}|Fixed some situations when {{AN|Burning Vengeance}} {{Stat|Damage}} was dealt multiple times.}} {{History|0.26|[[File:Kindlebane Dagger (v2).png|26px]] Added a custom texture for '''Kindlebane Dagger''' as part of the SkyBlock Resource Pack.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Blaze}} [[Category:Daggers]]
